d: Bihar ke khagriya jile ke SP IPS bhanu pratap sinh aur unki patni puja sinh ka parivarik vivad surkhiyon men hai. 2016 men donon ne prem vivah kiya tha, lekin puja ka aarop hai ki IPS banne ke bad bhanu pratap talak ka dabav bana rahe hain aur 6 sal ki beti se milne nahin de rahe. puja ne espi aavas men marpit aur pratarna ke aarop lagate hue patna men mukhyamantri aavas ke bahar dharna bhi diya. halanki puja talak nahin, balki parivar ko phir se basana chahti hain. pura mamla mahila aayog aur thane tak pahunch chuka hai. janie is pure vivad ki puri insaid stori.
